messages:
Elena: New mock for Roles + Audit tweaks. Goal: reduce toolbar footprint, make SSO language explicit, surface audit filters. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc (frame: roles-mini).

Ravi: Looks cleaner. Concern: hiding 'Bulk invite' under overflow might hide it from admins who do batch on/off boarding. Could we show it when pending CSV imports exist? :thinking:

Priya: Accessibility callout: if labels collapse to icons at wide widths, ensure each button has aria-label and a visible focus ring. Also modals need focus on the first input.

Jon: SSO copy tweak suggestion: "Enforce SSO sign-in for all members" with smaller help text: "Disables password login. Configure IdP in Security → SSO." Less ambiguous than "Require SSO."

Kai: Audit filter: +1 to a sticky filter bar. Current filters disappear after paging which confuses people. Also prefer ISO dates `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm` in the table.

Elena: Proposed responsive rules for ticket: full text <800px, icon+text 800-1400px, icon-only >1400px with tooltip showing keyboard hint. Add undo in the SSO toggle toast.

Ravi: Copy: replace "Grant" with "Assign" across the panel. More understandable.

Priya: ARIA snippet for the PR: `<button aria-label=\"Invite members to organization\" aria-haspopup=\"true\"></button>` and `role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"true\"` on modals. I'll add checklist to PR.

Jon: Also propose microcopy under SSO toggle: "Admins can manage SSO in Security → SSO." avoids support pings.

Kai: Low-priority: support `g a` to jump to Audit and `g r` for Roles. Nice for power users.

ux-bot: NOTE: a11y checklist attached to prototype. Prototype updated -> roles-mini-v1a.

Elena: Thanks all. I'll update Figma with sticky filters, ISO dates, copy swaps, and toast undo. Will post new link when ready.
